signals.signal: Eurobank Holdings 2Q2026 results presentation (dated 30/07/2026) reports the Bulgaria country segment at 30/06/2026: 181 retail branches + 11 business/private banking centres, headcount 3,272 (down from 3,349 at 31/03/2026), total assets EUR 14,600m, net loans EUR 9,819m, deposits EUR 11,640m, CAD 21.0%; 1H26 adjusted net profit EUR 119m (+7.8% y-o-y), core PPI EUR 177m (+17.6%). At 31/03/2026 the same disclosure showed 182 branches + 11 centres and headcount 3,349.
signals.implies: Branches drifting down and headcount -77 in a single quarter while the balance sheet grew ~4.5% q-o-q: the classic profile of a bank pushing transactions off the counter onto self-service. Printec: ATM/self-service, cash recyclers (TCR) to absorb branch cash work, managed services for the estate.
signals.likelihood: High that self-service migration continues through 2026-27
signals.followup: Track the 3Q26 deck (Nov-2026) for further branch/headcount drift and any Bulgaria-specific capex disclosure.

signals.signal: The bank's own branch/ATM locator (postbank.bg/Contacts/Network), scraped 30/07/2026 from the server-rendered data-types attributes, returns 665 location records: 498 ATM locations of which 225 are flagged isATMWithDeposit (cash-deposit function, ~45%); 167 branch locations; 154 self-service / Express Banking digital zones, 137 of them 24/7; 71 specialised centres; 50 Priority Desk branches.
signals.source_name: Postbank - Клонова мрежа и контакти (locator page)
signals.implies: First primary, current-dated view of the estate. The baseline '>450 ATMs' is now ~498 ATM LOCATIONS and 154 Express Banking zones (vs the >120 contactless devices cited back in 2021). 273 ATM locations remain cash-out only = direct recycler/TCR white space; the 225 deposit-capable sites are the natural upgrade path to full recycling. Printec: ATM/self-service supply, cash automation/recyclers, managed services.
signals.likelihood: Certain as a current-state measure; site refresh cadence unknown
signals.followup: Re-scrape monthly to trend ATM / deposit-ATM / zone counts. CAVEAT: these are LOCATIONS, not devices - a site can host more than one machine. Seek a device-level figure in the FY2026 annual report.

signals.signal: Postbank opened 'Postbank Next', a next-generation phygital office at XOPark (described as Bulgaria's largest retail park), organised into five zones: Express Digital Zone (unassisted transactions), Digital Zone, Interactive Zone, Assisted Zone and a Video Consultation Zone. The concept was first flagged in the 28/04/2026 rebrand as 'a new generation of Postbank NEXT offices'.
signals.source_name: Economic.bg - Postbank задава посоката на модерното банкиране с Postbank Next
signals.implies: A live branch-format pilot that hard-wires self-service and video banking into the floor plan. Each replication needs recyclers/kiosks, queueing and identification tech and remote-advisory infrastructure. Printec: self-service devices, cash recyclers, digital onboarding/eKYC in the assisted and video zones, managed services.
signals.likelihood: Medium-High that further NEXT offices follow in 2026-27
signals.followup: Chase the primary Postbank press release and any stated rollout target (number of NEXT offices, budget, device spec); watch for a second NEXT site.

signals.signal: On 28/04/2026 Postbank relaunched with a modernised visual identity and the 'Inspired by you' positioning for its 35th anniversary, adopting the Latin spelling 'Postbank'. The repositioning is anchored on the Postbank NEXT office generation and on already-completed digital programmes: 100+ AI solutions, a new mobile banking platform, next-generation front-office systems, a new card platform, and completed migration of systems to the euro.
signals.implies: Card platform, front office and mobile were all replaced in the last cycle - the physical self-service device layer is the conspicuous remaining legacy, and a rebrand normally forces ATM/kiosk fascia and screen-flow refresh anyway. Printec: self-service refresh, POS/acquiring, HSM/security around the new card platform.
signals.likelihood: High that a device-layer refresh follows the software refresh
signals.followup: Identify who supplied the new card platform and front-office system - it frames who is positioned for the device layer. Also check whether ATM screen branding has been reskinned (a paid project in its own right).

signals.signal: Postbank runs a programme of 100+ AI projects across customer service, lending, communication, risk analysis, operations, marketing, security and data analytics, with two AI development centres established in 2025; 12 projects fully implemented and 8 in delivery as at 20/11/2025. EVA moved from chatbot to AI voice bot on the call-centre line from the start of 2026; by Mar-2026 EVA is cited as serving 1.2m+ users and having answered 8m+ enquiries with sub-0.1s response. The bank states over 96% of its transactions are conducted online.
signals.implies: The service layer is being automated aggressively; with >96% of transactions online, the residual branch workload is cash handling and identity. Printec: cash automation/recyclers to strip out the last manual cash handling, digital onboarding/eKYC, AML and transaction monitoring as AI use-cases the bank is already funding.
signals.followup: Confirm EVA's underlying platform vendor and find the 2026 update on how many of the 100 AI projects are live.

signals.signal: On 15/07/2026 Postbank launched a fully in-app customer registration flow in Postbank App: online registration in minutes ending with an active current account, a digital debit card, activated mobile/internet banking and a chosen package programme - with no branch visit and no paper. The flow includes remote identification, automated checks, electronic signing of documents, and NFC scanning of the national ID card for document/identity verification; the physical card is then delivered free to an address or branch.
signals.source_name: Postbank Media Center - Само минути до ежедневното банкиране с Postbank
signals.implies: Postbank now has production remote onboarding with NFC eID reading and remote e-signature - the exact stack Printec sells as digital onboarding/eKYC. This is both a competitive datapoint (someone else supplied it) and a pull-through: the same identity rails will be wanted in branch, at the NEXT video-consultation zone, and on self-service devices for card issuance/re-issuance.
signals.likelihood: Live now; extension to branch/self-service channels likely 2026-27
signals.followup: Identify the eKYC/remote-identification vendor behind the NFC ID + e-signature flow; probe whether the same identity service will be exposed on ATMs/kiosks.

signals.signal: On 22/06/2026 Postbank announced it had been selected to the European Commission's EU AI Act Advisory Forum after a c.10-month selection process, chosen from 700+ applicant organisations, and is the only bank from Central and Eastern Europe in the c.170-member forum (alongside OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral AI, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, Hugging Face, Qualcomm).
signals.source_name: Postbank Media Center - Международно признание: Postbank беше избрана за член на Консултативния AI форум към ЕК
signals.implies: Postbank is positioning itself as the CEE reference account for compliant AI in banking. Any AI-bearing product sold into it (AML scoring, transaction monitoring, biometric/eKYC) will face an AI Act governance bar - vendors that can evidence high-risk-AI conformity have an edge. Printec: AML/compliance and transaction monitoring, framed around AI Act conformity.
signals.followup: Verify membership against the European Commission's published Advisory Forum member list; use it as an entry hook for AI-governed compliance tooling.

signals.entity: Postbank (Eurobank Bulgaria AD) / Bulgarian banking sector
signals.signal: CEO Petia Dimitrova (also chair of the Association of Banks in Bulgaria) reports on the euro changeover: c. EUR 200m invested by the sector in preparation (technology, logistics, training, organisational capacity); card-system adjustment completed in three hours on 01/01/2026 with card payments and euro ATM withdrawals possible from the first seconds of the year; 240,000+ customers served in branches in the first business days; more than BGN 27bn - over 91% of levs in circulation - withdrawn from circulation by end-March 2026; 28 training sessions run by the ABB and BNB.
signals.source_name: Postbank Media Center - Petia Dimitrova: Bulgaria's Euro Era Begins
signals.implies: Quantifies the one-off changeover spend that is now finished - meaning 2026-27 IT budgets are freed for discretionary projects rather than mandatory conversion. The 240,000-customer branch surge and BGN 27bn cash repatriation also stress-tested cash logistics and vault/counting capacity. Printec: cash automation/recyclers, cash-cycle and CIT optimisation, managed services.
signals.likelihood: High that freed budget rotates to self-service/branch modernisation in 2026-27
signals.followup: Ask the bank directly what share of the EUR 200m was Postbank's and what the 2026-27 successor budget targets.

signals.signal: BNB main payment-statistics indicators (workbook last updated 22/07/2026): ATM terminals in Bulgaria 5,031 at end-2025, down from 5,087 (2024), 5,128 (2023) and a 5,751 peak in 2016 - a fourth consecutive annual decline; POS terminals 210,861 at end-2025 vs 163,190 at end-2024 (+29.2%). Card cash withdrawals fell to 60.7m transactions / EUR 13.7bn in H2-2025 (from 64.2m in H2-2024) while card cash DEPOSITS rose to 5.8m / EUR 3.7bn in H2-2025 and 6.73m / EUR 3.5bn in H1-2025 (from 4.8m / EUR 2.5bn in H2-2024).
signals.source_name: Bulgarian National Bank - Основни показатели от статистиката на плащанията (ps_mainindicators_new_eur_bg.xlsx)
signals.implies: The national ATM base is shrinking while deposit volumes at ATMs grow and withdrawals fall - exactly the mix that justifies replacing dispense-only machines with recyclers rather than adding units. The +29.2% POS jump is a euro-driven acceptance boom. Printec: cash recyclers/TCRs, POS/acquiring terminals and merchant services.
signals.likelihood: Trend well established across four years
signals.followup: Pull the H1-2026 update (first full euro half-year) when BNB publishes it, and split ATM deposits by bank if the detailed tables allow.

signals.signal: Audited FY2025 consolidated statements: intangible-asset additions of BGN 32.08m in 2025 (software BGN 27.00m, licences BGN 2.72m, internally developed BGN 2.36m), down from BGN 42.25m in 2024. Post-balance-sheet event disclosed: in February 2026 the Group agreed to acquire a controlling interest in a Bulgarian software company for c. EUR 18m upfront plus consideration contingent on future profitability, subject to regulatory approval and expected to complete in H1 2026.
signals.source_name: Eurobank Bulgaria AD - Consolidated Annual Financial Statements & Activity Report, 31 December 2025 (PDF)
signals.implies: A recurring BGN 27-42m/yr software spend confirms a real IT budget. The c. EUR 18m software-house purchase signals in-sourcing of build capability, which typically shifts third-party spend away from bespoke development toward hardware, platforms and managed services - favourable for a device+managed-services vendor, unfavourable for custom software.
signals.followup: IDENTIFY the acquired software company via the Bulgarian Commercial Register / Eurobank announcements - if it is a payments or self-service house it materially changes the competitive map in BG.

signals.signal: Six months after the e-Postbank / m-Postbank internet and mobile banking replatforming, the bank reports over 95% of all transactions online, +113% growth in mobile transfer volumes and +120% growth in m-Postbank app interactions year-on-year; a new in-app parking-payment service signed up 5,000+ users in its first days; ONE wallet is positioned as the first Bulgarian digital wallet also aimed at 14-18 year-olds. Moody's affirmed Postbank's long-term deposit rating at A3 on 27/07/2026 (raised to A3 in July 2025, third upgrade in a year), and BCRA affirmed its ratings on 03/07/2026.
signals.source_name: Postbank Media Center - Новото дигитално банкиране на Пощенска банка с рекорден ръст и одобрение; Postbank Media Center RSS (Moody's / BCRA items)
signals.implies: Digital channels are carrying the volume and the bank has ratings headroom (A3, affirmed 27/07/2026) to fund capex. What is left in physical is cash and identity - the two things a recycler-plus-eKYC proposition addresses. Printec: cash automation, self-service, eKYC.
signals.followup: Get the 12-month update on the replatforming metrics and the digital-active-customer count from the FY2026 report.

signals.signal: RE-VERIFICATION of a flagged-stale baseline item: the 'over 120 contactless ATMs and self-service devices in Express Banking digital zones' claim, and the statement about expanding the network and replacing existing ATMs in offices nationwide, both originate from a Postbank press release dated 14/01/2021 - not from any 2026 announcement. No 2026-dated Postbank release restates a device count.
signals.source_name: Postbank Media Center - Пощенска банка с нова безконтактна функционалност на банкомати и устройства за самообслужване
signals.implies: Do NOT carry '>120 devices' or 'nationwide ATM replacement' as current. The live number to use is the 30/07/2026 locator scrape (154 Express Banking zones, 498 ATM locations). The 2021 replacement statement is five years old and there is no evidence of a completed nationwide swap - which keeps the refresh opportunity open rather than closing it.
signals.followup: Retire the 2021 figures from the baseline; substitute the locator counts and re-scrape monthly.

coverage_notes: Fresh full run (no checkpoint existed). Bulgarian- and English-language search used across bank site, media centre, business press (economic.bg, banker.bg, investor.bg, Bloomberg TV BG, Forbes BG), regulator and rating-agency angles. GAP - FLEET OEM STILL UNIDENTIFIED: no vendor is named in any Postbank disclosure. Routes exhausted this run: LinkedIn guest jobs API (keyword ATM + Bulgaria, and Postbank company feed - no ATM/self-service roles), careers.postbank.bg, dev.bg / h512 employer profiles, BG+EN vendor searches (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf, Wincor, Printec), euro-changeover technical coverage, the FY2025 audited statements, and the locator HTML. One search engine attributed a '75 NCR Atleos ATMs delivered by Printec' line to Postbank BG - this is almost certainly a conflation with the AikBank Serbia deal in the baseline and is NOT reported. Also NOT resolved: identity of the c.EUR 18m Bulgarian software company Eurobank agreed to buy in Feb-2026; the number of Postbank NEXT offices planned; device-level (as opposed to location-level) ATM and self-service counts; the vendor behind the new card platform, front-office system and the NFC-eID onboarding flow.

No source was silently dropped.
